2607.28312.title: ObjectStream: Latent Objects as Memory Anchors for Streaming Video Understanding
2607.28312.paper_summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to continuously retain useful visual evidence before future questions are known. Existing approaches primarily manage the growing visual context according to token importance, temporal redundancy, or segment-level relevance, but rarely organize evidence around objects that persist and evolve over time. Thus, in this paper, we introduce ObjectStream, a training-free framework that treats latent objects as memory anchors for streaming video understanding. ObjectStream induces spatially coherent latent objects directly from frozen Video-LLM representations, links them across frames into persistent anchors, and maintains their histories under a bounded memory budget, without requiring external object detectors or segmentation models. Built on these anchors, ObjectStream preserves three complementary forms of evidence: persistent object histories, transient object changes, and recent visual context. This design enables existing Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over object identities, interactions, and state changes while leaving the underlying model unchanged. Extensive experiments on online streaming and offline long-video benchmarks demonstrate both effectiveness and efficiency. In online streaming evaluation, ObjectStream improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 10.0 points on OVO-Bench Real-Time Visual Perception, while reducing peak GPU mem-ory and TTFT by approximately 50%. On offline long-video benchmarks, it surpasses the full-token baseline while discarding 82.5% of visual tokens. These results highlight latent objects as a practical and effective organizing principle for compact streaming video memory.
2607.28312.paper_summary_zh: 串流視頻理解需要模型在未來問題尚未明確之前持續保留有用的視覺證據。現有的方法主要根據標記的重要性、時間冗餘或片段級相關性來管理不斷增長的視覺上下文，但很少圍繞隨時間持續和演變的物體組織證據。因此，在本文中，我們介紹了ObjectStream，一個無需訓練的框架，將潛在物體視為串流視頻理解的記憶錨點。ObjectStream直接從凍結的Video-LLM表示中引導空間一致的潛在物體，將它們跨幀鏈接成持久的錨點，並在有限的記憶預算下維護它們的歷史，而無需外部物體檢測器或分割模型。在這些錨點的基礎上，ObjectStream保留了三種互補的證據形式：持久的物體歷史、瞬時的物體變化和最近的視覺上下文。這一設計使現有的視頻大型語言模型（Video-LLMs）能夠推理物體的身份、互動和狀態變化，同時保持底層模型不變。在在線串流和離線長視頻基準上的廣泛實驗展示了其有效性和效率。在在線串流評估中，ObjectStream使Qwen2.5-VL-7B在OVO-Bench實時視覺感知上提高了10.0分，同時將峰值GPU記憶體和TTFT減少了約50%。在離線長視頻基準上，它超越了全標記基線，同時丟棄了82.5%的視覺標記。這些結果突顯了潛在物體作為緊湊串流視頻記憶的實用和有效的組織原則。
